name: IIT Bombay — MTech via GATE 2027 (CSE / AI & DS)
org: IIT Bombay (also IITM, IITH, IISc via same GATE score)
elig_note: No upper age limit for GATE. Final-year students can register, so the Jan 2027 BS completion is fine. 4-year BS is a valid GATE qualifier; confirm IITB department-level 'valid UG degree, 60%' clause accepts IITM BS (7.5 CGPA clears 60%).
notes:
URGENT: GATE 2027 registration closes 27 Sep 2026 without late fee (late-fee window runs a bit longer). Exam 6–21 Feb 2027. Counselling via COAP ~May–Jun 2027.

Paper choice: GATE DA (Data Science & AI) maps directly onto the IITM BS syllabus. GATE CS is the standard route into IITB CSE. One score feeds IITB, IITM, IITH, IISc and others, valid 3 years.

Reality check: TA stipend is not a household income. The real cost is 2 years full-time residential in Powai and income forgone. Only makes sense if the degree + IIT network outweighs that.

Open: verify whether IITB C-MInDS AI & DS MTech takes GATE DA.

name: Fulbright-Nehru Master's Fellowship
elig_note: Fields restricted to economics, environment, higher-ed admin, international affairs/law, journalism, public admin, public health, urban planning, gender studies, arts management. CS/AI/DS not eligible.
notes: Open to Indians, but not for this field. The earlier 15 Oct deadline was wrong — the window typically runs Feb–May.
